name: Raffles Jakarta
positioning: Art-filled Raffles hotel in the Kuningan district of Jakarta's golden triangle, built around the work of Indonesian painter Hendra Gunawan
best_for: Travelers interested in Indonesian art and Hendra Gunawan's work
City visitors wanting a base linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre
Guests who want a spa stay with Indonesian heritage treatments

facts.text: Raffles Jakarta was founded by Dr (HC) Ir. Ciputra, an avid collector of Hendra Gunawan paintings.
The hotel has installations articulating subjects from Gunawan's paintings, especially rural life and nature.
The hotel is in the Kuningan district of Jakarta's golden triangle and is linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre.
Rooms are infused with the creative influence of local artist Hendra Gunawan.
The Raffles Club is on the 12th floor with views of the Jakarta skyline.
Raffles Jakarta butlers are trained by Heilbron Hospitality and Aspire Globally.
Arts Cafe serves Continental and Asian a la carte dishes with a backdrop of Hendra Gunawan's artwork.
Arts Cafe has a Japanese corner and desserts from Raffles Patisserie.
The Writers Bar hosts evenings of live jazz piano with signature rum cocktails.
Raffles Spa has six treatment suites, an outdoor whirlpool and steam rooms, plus an outdoor pool.
The spa uses Kerstin Florian products for facials and Tropical Spa for body care.
The Signature Heritage Massage incorporates Lomi Lomi, Balinese and Javanese techniques.

highlights.text: Ciputra opened Raffles Jakarta in March 2015 as a place where Hendra Gunawan's legacy comes to life.
The linked Ciputra Artpreneur Centre is home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, a gallery and a Broadway Musical Theatre.
Navina Pool Bar offers cabana dining in the Hendra Gunawan Garden on the 14th floor.
A Raffles Royal Host is a historian with knowledge of the hotel and its art collection.
Bathrobes are designed by IKAT Indonesia by Didiet Maulana, inspired by Hendra Gunawan artworks and local batik patterns.

considerations.text: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport is about 28 km away.
WhataHotel notes limited outdoor recreational facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
